name: GhostToolbar
description: Headless APG toolbar container. useGhostToolbar owns role and orientation semantics; useRovingFocus moves among focusable slot children. Themed flex layout lives on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element tag for the toolbar container.

props.name: dir
props.description: Optional text direction for horizontal arrow reversal in RTL.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name via aria-label when a visible label element is not used.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap arrow and Home/End movement from last enabled item to first.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Toolbar layout and roving arrow axis. Sets aria-orientation when vertical.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Toolbar items such as GhostButton, GhostSwitch, and GhostSeparator.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Root element after mount; null before mount.

keyboard.ArrowLeft: Previous enabled item when orientation is horizontal (flipped in RTL).
keyboard.ArrowRight: Next enabled item when orientation is horizontal (flipped in RTL).
keyboard.ArrowUp: Previous enabled item when orientation is vertical.
keyboard.ArrowDown: Next enabled item when orientation is vertical.
